import { Aside, Steps } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

This template turns receipt photos (`IMG_2041.jpg`), emailed PDFs, and scans into expense records you can reconcile from the filename: store, date, amount, and an optional category from your own list.

## Naming pattern

```
{Detected Date} – {Vendor} – {Amount} – {Category}
```

| Block | Source | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Detected Date | The purchase date on the receipt | `2026-06-03` |
| Vendor | The store or merchant | `Whole Foods` |
| Amount | Total with currency code | `84 USD` |
| Category | Custom AI Block choosing from your expense categories | `Meals` |

## Before and after

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| `IMG_2041.jpg` | `2026-06-03 – Whole Foods – 84 USD – Meals.jpg` |
| `scan_receipt.pdf` | `2026-06-01 – Amazon – 129 USD – Hardware.pdf` |
| `receipt (2).jpg` | `2026-06-07 – Shell Gas – 52 USD – Travel.jpg` |

## Build it

<Steps>
1. Create a Template named "Receipts & Expenses" (or start from the built-in Bookkeeper Expenses template and adjust it).
2. Add **Detected Date**, **Vendor**, and **Amount** [Naming Blocks](/docs/naming-blocks); set the date format to `YYYY-MM-DD`.
3. Add a [Custom AI Block](/docs/custom-ai-blocks) with your category list — for example "Software, Travel, Meals, Office Supplies, Hardware, Parking".
4. Test on a mixed batch: a photographed paper receipt, an emailed PDF, and a scan. AI vision reads photos and image-only scans directly.
5. Assign the Template to [folder monitoring](/docs/folder-monitoring) on the synced folder where receipt photos and downloads land.
</Steps>

<Aside type="tip">
Photograph paper receipts into one cloud-synced folder from your phone; the monitored Template names them as they sync. HEIC photos are supported — no conversion step.
</Aside>
